title: Cosmic Melting Orb
description: A surreal desert landscape features a massive black spherical orb with a glowing orange eye and lava-like cracks, melting vibrant colorful paint downwards. In the background stands a stepped stone pyramid, two celestial bodies in the purple sky, comets, and numerous translucent bubbles floating throughout the scene.
prompt: Surreal desert scene with a giant black orb floating in the left foreground, cracked with glowing orange lava and a central eye, dripping colorful paint in yellow, green, purple and red. Stepped ancient pyramid on the right, two moons in the purple sky, shooting stars, and many translucent bubbles scattered across the composition, dramatic cosmic lighting, painterly style.
